decisions.decision: Trash rebuilt as a native component (TrashView.tsx) rather than restyled from Classic's Trash.tsx
decisions.rationale: Figma prototype has no separate Trash page at all (App.tsx:705-715,2203) - it's a filter on the normal list/detail chrome. Classic's Trash.tsx is architecturally a full-width page, so restyling it in place would preserve the wrong shape. TrashView can't literally reuse ItemList/DetailPanel either since listSites excludes every trashed row while list_trash returns its own credential-level DTO shape - built as a second, smaller list+detail pair in the same visual language instead.

decisions.decision: Per-item permanent delete not added to Trash
decisions.rationale: Backend only has bulk purge_trash (no purge_one_credential command); adding one would be new backend scope beyond 'restyle/fix the architecture', which is out of bounds for this round
